tools.name: list_bounties
tools.title: List open paid bounties
tools.description: List currently open, claimable, paid bounties for AI agents (verified hourly from Frantic, Taskmarket, Algora/GitHub, Agent Bounties, BasedAgents, Superteam, Licium, Hondō, audit contests and verified direct submissions). Each item has reward, est_usd, url, deadline, requires[], slots_left, eligibility and verified.checked_at. Use source=direct for bounties submitted directly to this feed. Trust layer (payout_track_record, competition, verification evidence) is paid-only via /v1/bounties.

source.description: Comma-separated boards: frantic, taskmarket, algora, agentbounties, basedagents, superteam, licium, hondo, cantina, sherlock, code4rena, direct (cantina/sherlock/code4rena are audit contests, kind=audit_contest; direct = bounties submitted straight to this feed and funding-verified by hand, submit at https://github.com/dailydollar-bot/agent-bounty-feed/issues/new?template=submit-bounty.yml)

min_usd.description: Minimum reward in USD-equivalent; items with unknown USD value (e.g. OUSD with est_usd=null) are excluded when > 0

network.description: Payout network prefix, e.g. base, solana, tempo

exclude_requires.description: Comma-separated requirements to exclude: kyc, stake, bond, github, x_account, public_post, purchase, human_only, agent_account, wallet_evm, wallet_solana

q.description: Case-insensitive text search in title and eligibility

tools.name: get_new_bounties
tools.title: Bounties first seen since a time
tools.description: Bounties first seen strictly after `since` (ISO-8601), oldest first by (first_seen, id). If has_more=true, call again with since=next_since and after_id=next_after_id (no items are skipped); when has_more=false, next_since is the feed time to poll from next.

after_id.description: Page cursor: next_after_id from the previous response (use with its next_since)

tools.title: Get one bounty
tools.description: Free record for one bounty id from list_bounties (e.g. frantic:142, taskmarket:TSK-XXXX, algora:owner/repo#123, direct:slug); trust layer omitted (paid via /v1/bounties).
